scope: Firestore rules source review and backend privacy contract
summary: Owner-only family and alert reads; all client writes denied. Source review only, not an emulator authorization certification.

findings.description: Default deny and owner-scoped family/alerts reads; no client write grants.
Backend validation no longer echoes rejected inputs. Alert records use the explicit metadata whitelist.
Transactional per-user rate limits and bounded push fanout.
Admin SDK bypasses Firestore rules. Production attestation, rules emulator checks, and FCM delivery still require live acceptance.
